title: A festival invitation
intro: The town is preparing a Kurdish language festival. Help deliver the invitation.

steps.en: The school is near the hospital.
I am going to school today.
We are learning Kurdish together.

title: Welcome our guests
intro: Prepare a comfortable place for the festival guests.

steps.en: Please sit on this chair.
The chair is beside the table.
Our guests are in the house.

title: Shopping for the feast
intro: Visit the market and buy fruit to share.

steps.en: I want to buy three apples.
How much does this apple cost?
These apples are fresh and delicious.

title: A picnic meeting
intro: Choose a peaceful place for the visitors to meet.

steps.en: There is a tree in the park.
We are sitting under the tree.
Please keep the park clean.

title: Help at the farm
intro: Ask the farmer about the animals and festival supplies.

steps.en: The cow is eating grass.
The farmer is working on the farm.
We need milk for our guests.

title: Bake a welcome treat
intro: Help the kitchen team prepare something sweet.

steps.en: This small cake is delicious.
Please wash your hands before cooking.
steps.ckb: تکایە پێش چێشت لێنان دەستەکانت بشۆ.

steps.en: We are making food for the festival.
steps.ckb: ئێمە خواردن بۆ جەژنەکە ئامادە دەکەین.

title: Repair the festival sign
intro: Help the maker repair a sign before the guests arrive.

steps.en: Please give me the screwdriver.
The tools are on the table.
We are repairing the sign together.

title: Visitors from around the world
intro: Use the globe to welcome visitors and talk about travel.

steps.en: This is a map of the world.
Where do you come from?
I want to learn about other countries.
steps.ckb: دەمەوێت دەربارەی وڵاتانی دیکە فێر ببم.

title: A gentle wildlife walk
intro: Show the visitors the animals without disturbing them.

steps.en: The rabbit has long ears.
Please do not frighten the animals.
We are watching the animals quietly.
steps.ckb: ئێمە بە بێدەنگی سەیری ئاژەڵەکان دەکەین.

title: Ready for the celebration
intro: Get dressed and finish welcoming the festival guests.

steps.en: I am wearing a blue shirt.
The festival begins this evening.
steps.ckb: جەژنەکە ئەم ئێوارەیە دەست پێ دەکات.

steps.en: Welcome to our Kurdish language festival.
steps.ckb: بەخێربێن بۆ جەژنی زمانی کوردیی ئێمە.
